title: HOW TO #13: Build a Pool On Top Of a Skyscraper
caption:
How to build a pool on top of a skyscraper 🏙️🏊

80 floors up and a pool of water. 10 problems, 10 fixes: steel beams under the roof, 4 columns down to the ground, a waterproof membrane, glass walls, laminated glass, a pump, a heater, a retractable roof, flexible joints, a dedicated elevator. A pool 300 meters in the sky.

Would you swim here at night? Comment POOL below. Tag the friend who dreams of living at the top. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #14!
